title: Sources: SpaceX's AI unit held talks about leasing computing capacity to Microsoft, as it fully embraces the neocloud business despite Musk's initial reluctance (Grace Kay/The Information)
summary: Grace Kay / The Information: Sources: SpaceX's AI unit held talks about leasing computing capacity to Microsoft, as it fully embraces the neocloud business despite Musk's initial reluctance — SpaceX's AI unit held talks over the summer about leasing computing capacity to Microsoft, say people familiar with the matter …
